required_changes.description: Replace PatientV2 with a v3 schema: drop ssn, split name into given[]/family, replace patientId with identifier[]. Keep .strict() — no passthrough.

evidence.quote: ssn: z.string(), // present per v2 spec; not used by Cadence

required_changes.description: Compose a display string from given[]/family for appointment cards and SMS. Do not invent a new name format beyond joining family + given.
Read the Riverbend-namespaced identifier.value for booking FKs and GET-by-id. Persist the same string in appointments.patient_id.

existing_tests.name: contract: fixtures parse as PatientV2
existing_tests.why: Recorded v2 fixtures still have ssn/name/patientId; v3 schema.parse will throw.

existing_tests.name: reminders worker uses fixture name/phone
existing_tests.why: Fixture patient-483921.json is v2-shaped; worker reads patient.name.

evidence.quote: fetches patient phone/name from fixtures and logs an SMS (no live PIS)

recommended_new_tests.name: PatientV3.parse accepts given/family/identifier and rejects ssn
recommended_new_tests.fails_first_because: Current schema requires ssn and a string name; the new test's v3 fixture fails parse until the schema change lands.

recommended_new_tests.name: reminder SMS uses composed given/family, not a missing .name
recommended_new_tests.fails_first_because: Worker interpolates patient.name; a v3 patient object has no .name, so the assertion on message text fails first.

gaps.deficiency: Reminder worker fails closed on PIS errors but has no metric for schema.parse rejections, so a v3 cutover would look like a PIS outage.

evidence.quote: the worker now fails closed (no reminder rather than a possibly-wrong reminder)

gaps.recommended_instrumentation: Count Zod parse failures separately from HTTP/network failures on the PIS client (no payload fields in the metric labels).

grade_reasoning: Schema and client updates are mechanical, but composing a display name from given[]/family and remapping the booking FK onto identifier.value are contextual. ssn is unused outside the schema.

confidence.rationale: Call sites are in a small typed client; uncertainty is whether identifier.system values are documented in v3 yet (M1 OpenAPI).
